background: M6.11 observed enriched-10093 at tick175 with all eight border sites occupied, seven native bonds and resident mobile ID98; the cardinal blockage precedes the eighth bond. Distinguish geometric confinement onset from graph cycle closure.
questions: Does a native free mobile center occupant change the observed rate of 7-edge precursor closure to eight edges relative to an otherwise same native 7-edge structure with empty center?
Can a mobile native center remain geometrically confined for >=30 ticks inside a seven-original-edge scaffold (with or without subsequent eighth-edge closure)?
What part of any apparent effect is an observational selection/density/species/energy artifact?

fixed_sample.input: Original M6.4 natural creation from unfed-6101 config, no bonds at t0, no added chemistry/particles

seven_edge_candidate.native_component: Exactly eight material particle IDs connected by exactly seven original bonds (no external component attachments), degree multiset [1,1,2,2,2,2,2,2]
seven_edge_candidate.geometry: Exactly all 8 perimeter cells around one toroidal 3x3 center, checked using existing pocket_center
seven_edge_candidate.edge_test: All seven original bonds follow eight cyclic consecutive lattice perimeter pairs; exactly one of eight perimeter bonds absent
seven_edge_candidate.eligibility: Missing edge chemically allowed at candidate tick with both endpoints having spare valence and enough energy for formation_cost; report eligible and ineligible separately
seven_edge_candidate.grouping: Episodes keyed by center plus sorted material IDs and seven original edge IDs; if any original edge breaks, stop the episode even if it reforms in same tick; a subsequent reformation starts a new episode.

measurement.primary: At-risk exposure per post-step tick t in an original seven-edge episode before its first eighth-edge closure, and next-step t+1 native closure of missing original edge only when all seven originals never broke and all eight original material IDs remain at same positions. Compare eligible free_mobile vs eligible empty, stratified by density and missing-edge species pair; do not treat repeated ticks as independent trials.
measurement.independent_worlds: Number of distinct seed+density worlds with eligible 7-edge episodes, with any free_mobile center and with first valid closure, separated by strata; episodes and tick exposures are dependent.
measurement.barrier_duration: Count uninterrupted period of exactly same original 7 edge bonds and fixed 8 material perimeter positions, regardless whether eighth edge added/broken; require same original free mobile center ID at all observed steps; terminate on breaking any original edge even if immediately reformed; report 30 tick or more, right censor at end.
measurement.secondary: First episode per material set within world; controls using all first unique material sets vs repeated episodes; record no-events and zero-denominator groups, and one-tick transition 7 to 8.
measurement.causality: Observational, no significance tests from per-tick denominators; no survival tests from dependent episodes. Mechanics no catalysis; center occupation is not randomized.
measurement.replay: Unobserved run for both fixed checkpoints with full world hash, RNG fingerprint/draw counts, energy, dissipation, bond formation/break equal to observed.
measurement.integrity: No source files, physical laws, historical campaigns, master modifications. Track breaks using native event sink.

decisions.descriptive_closure: Report per-stratum eligible exposures, valid next-step closure, and per-world exposure summaries; observational differences do not prove causal influence.
decisions.persistent_barrier: If >=2 independently seeded worlds contain continuous 7-edge barrier and same native free mobile resident for >=30 observed ticks, label repeated_native_geometric_confinement_only; if 1 label single_unreplicated_30tick_confinement; else no_confirmed_30tick_confinement
decisions.limited_power: If <5 distinct worlds containing free_mobile eligible precursor, label closure_comparison_underpowered regardless of ratio.
